messages:
Sara (Growth): Heads up — dashboard spike after yesterday's 11am launch post. Leads up ~3x and webinar signups up ~2x. Looks like overlap between blog and webinar traffic. Anyone free to triage? @Ana (Analytics) :eyes:

Ana (Analytics): Got the alert and pulling the funnel now. Quick glance shows a lot of users with both blog_utm and webinar_utm within short windows. Sharing the rough query in a sec.

Mike (Marketing): I sent the broadcast at 11:05 and also boosted the blog post organically around the same time. Could be our timing fault. :grimacing:

Ana (Analytics): SQL I'm running:
```
SELECT user_id,
       min(event_time) AS first_touch,
       max(event_time) AS conv_time,
       array_agg(DISTINCT traffic_source) AS sources,
       COUNT(DISTINCT event_type) FILTER (WHERE event_type='signup') AS signups
FROM events
WHERE event_time >= '2026-03-20' AND event_time < '2026-03-21'
GROUP BY user_id
```
Prelim result: ~45 users had both blog and webinar sources within 60 minutes.

Olivia (Ops): Our lead router currently sets lead.source = last_utm. So that would credit webinar in many of these cases.

Jordan (Product): For the weekly KPI deck we usually present first-touch for acquisition, but for downstream MQL->SQL pipeline we care about the last-touch that triggered the form. We should show both to be safe.

Sara (Growth): For today's digest we need a quick decision. Proposal: publish both first-touch and last-touch counts in the dashboard, and add an "overlap" flag where multiple sources occurred within 2h. That will call out confounders.

Ana (Analytics): I can add a toggle to the dashboard for attribution window (0 / 2 / 24h) and produce a snapshot comparing first vs last counts. ETA ~30m.

Mike (Marketing): Also can we filter by campaign_id? The broadcast campaign likely drove most overlap — if we separate broadcast-driven clicks we can apportion.

Olivia (Ops): Routing recommendation: if overlap_flag = true AND time_diff <= 2h, route to mixed-nurture list and tag origin = 'broadcast-confound'. That keeps the pipeline deterministic.

Sara (Growth): Agreed. Action items: Ana adds toggle + snapshot, Ops adds mixed-nurture routing rule, Mike will annotate the mail send in the deck. We'll call out that timing caused the confounder. :thumbsup:

Ana (Analytics): Snapshot uploaded -> https://dash.redwood.ai/s/launch-spike-1969901234 (shows first_touch / last_touch / overlap_flag columns). Added a note in the widget explaining methodology.

Jordan (Product): For the weekly KPI slide we'll include both attribution models and a one-line note: "Mail send coincident with blog boost; use overlap flag to interpret spikes."

Mike (Marketing): Thanks — I'll avoid mixing two big promos in the same 2h window tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Dashboard deployment succeeded (build 523) :white_check_mark:
